nodes.label: S2 — Auth0 on Device, Bearer on Server (B1)
D14 — Auth0 callback scheme: plugin's {bundleId}.auth0 default
nodes.rationale: The bundle identifier is already per-variant unique, so the default scheme satisfies D7's uniqueness worry without threading variant.scheme through, and keeps the OAuth callback namespace separate from expo-router's own deep-link scheme.

nodes.label: D15 — jose becomes a direct web dependency
nodes.rationale: jose was only transitively resolvable via @auth0/nextjs-auth0 and livekit-client's chain; an unrelated Auth0 SDK upgrade dropping or majoring it would silently break token verification.

nodes.label: D16 — One withBearer wrapper for every v2 route
nodes.rationale: A per-route auth check fails open, silently, on a route that forgets it; a handler signature requiring ownerId makes that omission a compile error instead.

nodes.label: D17 — Lower API token lifetime to 300s to test renewal, then restore
nodes.rationale: Auth0's default 24h access-token lifetime makes the renewal gate untestable in a normal session; a forgotten 300s value is a silent-cost slow leak, so restoring it is recorded as an explicit step.

nodes.label: D18 — Minimal logout ships at S2
nodes.rationale: Without logout the login gate can only be exercised once per install on ad-hoc distribution, forcing a rebuild-reinstall cycle to re-test.

nodes.label: D19 — useDPoP: false, explicit
nodes.rationale: react-native-auth0 v5 defaults useDPoP to true, which would send Authorization: DPoP against a server that only verifies plain Bearer JWTs, producing 401s on tokens that decode perfectly — the hardest failure to debug.

nodes.label: D20 — No identifier committed; values come from the environment
nodes.rationale: Owner decision to keep the Auth0 client id, API identifier, tenant domain and agent id out of git even though none are confidential once shipped; MobileEnv still declares the field list so 'which values exist' stays answerable from a checkout while 'what are they' moves to .env / EAS env vars.

nodes.label: B1 — Native client Auth0 + Bearer server risk
